mapper.select: SELECT mc.*, c.coupon_name AS couponName, c.coupon_type AS couponType, c.coupon_value AS couponValue, c.min_amount AS minAmount, c.start_time AS startTime, c.end_time AS endTime FROM member_coupon mc LEFT JOIN coupon c ON mc.coupon_id = c.id WHERE mc.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY mc.create_time DESC
